_comment: Live arena: COMMANDER mode. Turtle runs the GrokBotWar Turtle bot's own v2 scripts (turtle-hero.js, turtle-drone-guard.js as drone type 'guard', turtle-battle-plan.js (battle plan; was turtle-commander.js); identical to its API submission of 2026-10-02 21:01). API submissions also persist across restarts (state/rosters.json). Turtle shows its identity badge (name 'GrokBotWar Turtle', empty shape/color -> fallback squircle in team color). Hunter uses a local sample image; Sniper's avatar was uploaded via the API; Chaos has none (arrow). Classic one-unit config: bots.classic.json. Seats marked "open": true (the 3 house seats) can be claimed by a new player on this computer with POST /api/seat/join (docs/ROBOT-API.md 9a); Turtle is never offered.
